# Dr Sorriso Donations

Match bank transfers to donors and record donations.

- Dates: 2023–2025
- Status: Internal automation
- Areas: Software engineering; AI / ML
- Stack: Python · Selenium · OpenAI API
- Topics: Python; Donor CRM; Analytics; Data Systems; Web/API
- Public case study: https://mgiorgetti.com/project_details/project-drsorrisodonations.html

## Problem

Inconsistent bank-transfer descriptions made identifying donors and recording donations in the foundation's existing platform labor-intensive.

## Contribution

Solo internal automation project for Fondazione Dottor Sorriso, combining donor extraction, repeated-input caching and Selenium-based entry into the existing platform.

## Technical approach and public case study

Match bank transfers to donors and enter donations in the foundation’s existing platform.

- Solo project

- March 2023–February 2025

- Python · Selenium

Campaign codes and donor names lead to the same donation record.

### Less time on manual entry

Processed more than 1,000 inconsistent donation records. The automation reduced manual data entry by 90%, saving the team an estimated 40 hours of administrative work per month.

### Identifying the donor

**Clean the description**

Rules remove SEPA boilerplate, banking identifiers, and repeated tokens. Italian name dictionaries help distinguish names from codes.

**Resolve the donor**

GPT-4o-mini proposes names across several calls. Agreement and a second pass check the result; a cache avoids parsing the same description again.

**Enter the record**

Selenium selects the campaign, finds or creates the contact, and enters the donation in the existing platform.

## Results and limitations

The reported operational result covers more than 1,000 donation records and a 90% reduction in manual entry. The 40 administrative hours saved per month is an estimate. Donor records and internal operational data are not published.
